title: Distinguishing zinc from lead using two reagents
question: Two colourless solutions, A and B, are tested with NaOH and NH₄OH. Solution A forms a white precipitate that dissolves in excess of both reagents. Solution B forms a white precipitate that dissolves in excess NaOH, but remains insoluble in excess NH₄OH. Which identification is correct?

diagramSvg:
